José Mujica, known as Pepe, was the president of Uruguay from 2010 to 2015. A former guerrilla who spent many years in prison, he became famous worldwide for his simple life.

In the 1960s he joined the Tupamaros, the urban guerrillas. He was shot and captured, and under the dictatorship spent about thirteen years in prison, much of it in solitary confinement in holes and cells. Freed in 1985, he entered politics with the left-wing Broad Front.

As president he lived on his small farm, drove an old Volkswagen Beetle and gave most of his salary away. His government legalised same-sex marriage, abortion and cannabis. His speeches against consumerism made him a hero to many abroad. He died in 2025, honoured across the parties of Uruguay, the country of Batlle.
